stem: Which of Mrs. Snavin’s actions helps the reader visualize why Jake is embarrassed?

options.label: A
options.text: Mrs. Snavin was my third-grade teacher, and she acted like computers were scary, especially the new ones.

options.label: B
options.text: She was confused about a program we were supposed to use for a math project.

options.label: C
options.text: Then she shook her head and let out this big sigh.

options.label: D
options.text: She said it so loud that every kid in the classroom stopped and turned to look at us, just in time to see Mrs. Snavin pat me on the top of my head like I was a nice little poodle or something.
